title.zh: Kraken Parent Payward Partners with Singapore Gulf Bank to Offer 24/7 Settlement
title.en: Kraken Parent Payward Partners with Singapore Gulf Bank to Offer 24/7 Settlement

current_state.zh: Payward, the parent of Kraken, has partnered with Bahrain-regulated Singapore Gulf Bank to plug into its SGB Net clearing network for 24/7 instant institutional settlement in Asia and the Gulf, with SGB also connecting to Kraken Prime for digital-asset liquidity.
current_state.en: Payward, the parent of Kraken, has partnered with Bahrain-regulated Singapore Gulf Bank to plug into its SGB Net clearing network for 24/7 instant institutional settlement in Asia and the Gulf, with SGB also connecting to Kraken Prime for digital-asset liquidity.
